## Sales Dashboard Snapshot

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg

- **Online sales** rise steadily from **12,000** to **16,050** across the 5 months.
- **Store sales** stay higher than online every month and climb from **18,000** to **19,300**.
- **Refunds** remain relatively small, but they spike in **2025-04** to **1,200**.

## Recommended Charts for the Dashboard

| Insight | Best Chart Type | Why it works | What to watch |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly sales growth by channel | **Line chart** | Shows the upward trend for Online vs Store sales clearly over time | Store sales grow more slowly but remain consistently stronger |
| Channel comparison each month | **Clustered bar chart** | Makes it easy to compare Online and Store sales side by side for each month | Helps highlight the widening or narrowing gap between channels |
| Refund movement over time | **Column chart** or **line chart** | Refunds are a smaller metric and need a clear time-based view | April stands out as the highest refund month |

## Main Trends and Anomalies

- **Overall growth:** Combined sales trend upward month by month, with the strongest end point in **2025-05**.
- **Online channel momentum:** Online sales increase every month, suggesting improving digital performance.
- **Store channel strength:** Store sales are consistently the largest revenue source, with a moderate but stable rise.
- **Refund behavior:** Refunds are usually around **900–1,100**, but **2025-04** is an anomaly at **1,200**.
- **Sales mix:** The gap between Store and Online sales remains substantial, so channel mix analysis is useful.

## Best Chart Choices by Insight

- **Trend over time:** Use a **line chart** for Online and Store sales.
- **Monthly comparison:** Use a **grouped bar chart** to compare channels per month.
- **Refund anomaly:** Use a **column chart** with a highlight on April, or a **line chart** if you want trend continuity.
- **Executive summary view:** Combine all three in one dashboard with sales trend on top, channel comparison in the middle, and refunds at the bottom.
